1.finding: The current 2026–2027 programme catalogue lists the same 5 EC module, Kämpfen, beten, schreiben (5631VB35Y), among the required courses in both years one and two. Its current module record confirms a single 5 EC course. The programme-specific regulations point to the guide as Appendix E and give no applicable replacement or repeat-credit provision. The historical guide identifies the module as part of the literature sequence but does not establish the missing current cohort allocation. Counting the module once preserves 60 + 55 + 60 = 175 EC.
